# Contextual producer with closed declared exceptions

One complete invariant producer binds the method's Object formal beside fixed
nominal context and scalar parameters. The direct result and the original
closed declared exception contract remain unchanged. Neither the callback nor
the signature predicts the provider's actual return value or execution policy.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK profiles compare virtual provider calls,
callback counts, mutable fields, result snapshots, ignored calls, late casts,
null order and checked/Error identity. Wrong programs must fail the observer;
original class/method identities, signatures, flags, parameters and Exceptions
are compared independently after compilation.
